items.q: The FSGS 75/25 rule states that 75% present with nephrotic syndrome while 25% show:
items.exp: 75%: nephrotic syndrome; 25%: asymptomatic/nephrotic proteinuria without syndrome. (Book p764)

items.q: The 25% asymptomatic arm of the 75/25 rule points to 2° perihilar FSGS (other cause: DM); the instruction written for this arm is:
items.exp: 2° perihilar FSGS (other cause: DM) → do not give immunosuppression. (Book p764)

items.q: The drug causes of 2° MN are gold, NSAIDs, d-penicillamine, captopril and:
items.exp: MN drugs: gold, NSAIDs, d-penicillamine, captopril, mercury. (Book p764)

items.q: The infection causes of 2° MN are hepatitis B virus, syphilis and:

items.exp: Rheumatoid arthritis: m/c glomerular manifestations: 2° amyloidosis > MN. (Book p764)

items.q: Sarcoidosis and IgG4-related disease, among MN autoimmune associations, produce:
items.exp: Sarcoidosis, IgG4 related disease: tubulointerstitial disease > glomerular (MN). (Book p764)

items.q: The malignancy linked to 2° MN is solid organ adenocarcinoma, and the most important one listed is:
items.exp: Solid organ adenocarcinoma: colorectal carcinoma (most important). (Book p764)

items.q: 1° MN is antibody-associated; the antibody written is:
items.exp: 1° MN: anti PLA2R (anti phospholipase A2 receptor antibody). (Book p764)

items.q: The MN presentation 70/30 rule splits into 70% nephrotic syndrome and 30% asymptomatic (microhematuria & proteinuria); the thrombosis note says MN carries:
items.exp: 70/30 rule; maximum risk of thrombosis. (Book p764)

items.q: The m/c cause of adult-onset nephrotic syndrome and of NS in children are respectively:
items.exp: m/c cause of adult onset nephrotic syndrome: MN; m/c cause of NS in children: MCD. (Book p764)
